messages:
kevin: heads-up: chart-ci started failing for gpu-runtime after eu overlay landed. schema reject: "spec.nodeSelector": expected object not null

emma: saw it. overlay kustomize patch removes nodeSelector to allow autoscaler flexibility -> helm template produces null which our validator complains about

prashant: this ties into capacity too. eu-west spot pools are exhausted; some teams intentionally remove nodeSelector to let on-demand nodes host pods. we shouldn't force configs that break that pattern

kevin: failing CI snippet from deploy-bot:
```nError: values.schema.json: "spec.nodeSelector" must be object
helm lint: exit status 1
```

jen: quick fixes: either make schema accept null or change chart templates to omit nodeSelector key when nil. both have tradeoffs. we could also add a small helper so templates guard presence

emma: example guard to only render key when map present:
```n{{- if .Values.nodeSelector }}
nodeSelector:
  {{ toYaml .Values.nodeSelector | indent 2 }}
{{- end }}
```
This avoids literal null in output and keeps overlays that remove the key working

prashant: ops perspective: if overlays remove nodeSelector, cluster autoscaler may schedule onto non-gpu nodes and cost will rise. we need a policy: allow on-demand fallback or require taints+tolerations and dedicated gpu pools

kevin: proposed immediate CI unblock: loosen values.schema.json "type": ["object", "null"] and add a unit check that simulates an overlay removing the key. longer term prefer template guards + docs

jen: suggested chart-ci changes:
- update values.schema to accept null for nodeSelector
- add helm-unit test rendering overlay-removed case
- allow temporary lint exception for this chart until fixes land

prashant: i'll open a terraform change to bump eu-west gpu spot pool by +2 nodes as a short-term mitigation; filing request now

kevin: PR WIP: https://github.com/redwood-inference/charts/pull/402 — contains schema tweak + test skeleton

sre-bot: observed 3 canaries in eu-west fail due to scheduling mismatch in last 24h, tagging @platform-ops for visibility

emma: also adding a short docs snippet for chart authors: "Don't assume nodeSelector exists; guard templates with an if/with or use lookup helpers" and include the example above

jen: action items: jen will land CI unit test, kevin will finish PR, prashant handles capacity terraform patch. follow up in channel tomorrow :thumbsup:
